description: Test vectors for buildShareText (apps/web/src/lib/share.ts), reused by the Flutter app (L-107). The text is the reference, the one-line insight (left out when empty) and the link, one per line. Whitespace runs become one space; the reference is cut to 100 and the insight to 160 code points, ellipsis included, at the last space when that keeps at least half of the room (else mid-word), dropping punctuation before the ellipsis; the query string is dropped so no tracking parameters travel; the fragment stays. Each invalid input throws.
